product.summary: HITS operates 'HyperLab,' an AI-based drug discovery SaaS platform. product.solution: HyperLab is a cloud-based SaaS that enables researchers to use AI tools without separate infrastructure. When a research goal is entered in natural language, AI agents handle the entire process from literature search, structure prediction, candidate design, to validation. It integrates about 120 computational tools, 160+ specialized functions, and 100+ databases into a single interface.

product.summary: An air-to-air hard-kill counter-UAS (C-UAS) interceptor system based on a high-speed eVTOL (electric vertical takeoff and landing) platform that directly strikes or captures enemy drones in midair. Core concept: the mothership AB-U60 carries small interceptor drones and deploys them in the air.
product.solution: The eVTOL mothership ascends first to close range, then deploys various interceptor drones (net capture type, direct impact type, fixed-wing launcher type) to physically neutralize enemy drones. Reduces per-engagement cost to $50–3,000.
key_features: AB-U60 mothership: wingspan 3m, max takeoff weight 60kg, payload 10kg, range 80km+, max speed 200 km/h. Can carry up to 4 small interceptors
AB-U10 net-gun capture type: 180 km/h, launches net to capture drone, airframe is reusable
AB-U2 direct impact type: small collision interceptor deployed from mothership, approx. KRW 10M per unit (est.)
AB-U4L fixed-wing launcher type: 300 km/h, long-range interceptor launched from launcher, approx. KRW 20M per unit (est.)

Onboard AI: autonomous mission execution even in communication-limited environments, integrates detection-strike-battle damage assessment into a single system by linking with external radar and EO/IR sensors
Tilt Duct propulsion enables both vertical takeoff/landing and high-speed cruise
Mass production readiness secured through 3D printing and composite material airframe manufacturing
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: High localization rate with in-house designed battery pack and flight control software. Proprietary technologies: distributed electric fan-jet propulsion, variable air intakes, modular hybrid-energy propulsion. Defines eVTOL not as a mere airframe but as 'Flying Physical AI,' advancing autonomy.
product.target_customer: Military (ROK Marine Corps, Defense Acquisition Program Administration), governments and defense ministries in the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Latin America, and security agencies for national critical infrastructure such as airports and power plants.
product.business_model: Starting with simple airframe sales, expanding to integrated air defense system sales covering detection→command & control→interception. Promoting local production and supply models via overseas joint ventures (JV) and MOUs.
product.problem_statement: A cost asymmetry problem: Patriot missiles (about $4M each), hundreds of times more expensive, are used to intercept low-cost drones (Shahed-class, about $35K each). The Ukraine war and Middle East conflicts have driven a sharp rise in drone threats, yet existing air defense systems are inefficient, and soft-kill methods such as jamming are ineffective against pre-programmed drones.
